newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: 11 die trapped in blazing Guatemala bus.
newsitem.headline: 11 die trapped in blazing Guatemala bus.

text.p: Eleven people burned to death on Monday and 24 others were injured when an explosion ripped through a bus in Guatemala City and passengers were trapped inside, emergency workers said.

An iron bar soldered and screwed into place across the back door emergency exit trapped dying passengers inside the bus and hampered firemen trying to rescue them, Cecilio Lopez, director of the National Guard, told reporters.
Firemen said the blaze was accidentally caused by two men who boarded the packed bus smoking cigarettes and carrying canisters of paint thinner.
A spark ignited the paint thinner, causing the explosion, said Julio Mariscal, spokesman for Guatemala City's volunteer fire department.

Broken glass surrounded the charred hulk of the bus where it had burned on a major street in the northern part of the capital. The blocked back door "greatly impeded the rescue workers, who had a lot of trouble getting inside the bus to put out the flames," Lopez said.

Fourteen different private bus companies run the thousands of aging, overcrowded buses that serve the majority of Guatemala's two million inhabitants. Lopez said the safety of the buses needed to be urgently reviewed.
